content.text: When platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad restrict access in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, digital creators are left without a reliable way to collect [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-only-real|Why Payment]] for their products. This is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-stripe|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] sovereignty comes in – [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-works-how-3|building]] a custom digital store that accepts crypto payments without relying on these platforms. In this guide, we'll explore how to use Supabase as the order database for digital stores, ensuring that creators have full control over their infrastructure and can accept payments from anywhere in the world.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to a successful digital store lies in its infrastructure. Using a platform like Stripe or PayPal may seem convenient, but it also means relying on a third-party service that can be restricted or shut down at any time. With infrastructure sovereignty, you have complete control over your digital store's architecture, allowing you to adapt to changing circumstances and ensure that your store remains online even when platforms fail. By using Supabase as the order database, you can store and manage orders independently, without relying on a centralized platform.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store's infrastructure, you'll need to gather a few essential tools. These include the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides a proven architecture for building a custom digital store, and the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), a pre-configured solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. You'll also need a domain name and a hosting service, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Additionally, you'll need to set up a payment gateway, like NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a low 0.5% fee.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your tools and infrastructure in place, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves configuring NOWPayments to accept crypto payments and integrating it with Supabase to store and manage orders. You'll also need to set up Cloudflare Workers to handle incoming payments and update the order status accordingly. This may require some technical expertise, but the result is a seamless payment and delivery experience for your customers.
With infrastructure sovereignty, you have complete control over your digital store's architecture and can adapt to changing circumstances.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After setting up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This involves deploying your Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and testing it thoroughly to ensure that everything is working as expected. Once you've completed the deployment process, you can start accepting payments from customers and processing orders using your custom infrastructure. Remember to test your payment and delivery pipeline regularly to ensure that it remains secure and reliable.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store's infrastructure is up and running, it's essential to scale it to meet growing demand. This involves monitoring your system's performance and adjusting it accordingly. You may need to add more resources to your hosting service or upgrade your payment gateway to handle increased traffic. By scaling your infrastructure, you can ensure that your digital store remains fast and reliable, even as it experiences rapid growth.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question a reader would ask is: 'Can I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?' The answer is yes – with infrastructure sovereignty, you can build a custom digital store that accepts crypto payments without relying on third-party platforms like Stripe or PayPal. By using Supabase as the order database and NOWPayments as the payment gateway, you can collect payments from customers and store orders independently, all while keeping costs low.

For more information on COREMERCH's products, including the Edge Commerce Stack and the Sovereign Starter Stack, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. You can also explore other products and services on the COREMERCH website.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your custom digital store, follow these steps: Gather the necessary tools, including the Sovereign Blueprint and the Edge Commerce Stack ($197); Set up a domain name and hosting service, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages; Configure NOWPayments to accept crypto payments and integrate it with Supabase to store and manage orders; Deploy your Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and test it thoroughly to ensure that everything is working as expected; Monitor your system's performance and adjust it accordingly to scale your infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 (GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments) is a more basic solution that can be deployed in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 (Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments) is a more comprehensive solution that is deployed in 48 hours with end-to-end testing. The choice between the two depends on your specific needs and requirements.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both services offer free hosting options that are ideal for small to medium-sized digital stores. However, for larger stores, you may need to consider a paid hosting service.
How long does it take to deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197)?

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is deployed in 48 hours with end-to-end testing. This comprehensive solution includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, and is perfect for larger digital stores that require a high level of scalability and reliability.
What is the cost of the Edge Commerce Stack ($197)?

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a one-time payment that includes 30-day support. This comprehensive solution is ideal for larger digital stores that require a high level of scalability and reliability.
Can I upgrade my payment gateway to handle increased traffic?

Yes, you can upgrade your payment gateway to handle increased traffic. By monitoring your system's performance and adjusting it accordingly, you can ensure that your digital store remains fast and reliable even as it experiences rapid growth.
